headline: Micron and Chip Stocks Decline on Tesla and Lam Research Forecasts
summary: Shares of Micron and other semiconductor companies fell following Tesla's reduction to its near-term spending target and a weaker-than-expected forecast from Lam Research.
why: Micron Technology is a major manufacturer of computer memory and data storage products. Chip sector performance is closely tied to capital expenditure trends across automotive and technology industries.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Weaker equipment forecasts and lower capital spending targets weigh broadly on chip stocks.

why_moved: Investors reacted negatively to reduced near-term capital expenditure guidance from Tesla and a disappointing forecast by Lam Research, dampening sector-wide sentiment.
